comment: Pinned workstation build tools. Host runtime pins are reviewed separately in matsci-ops/deploy/runtime-versions.env; these are the tools the ingest pipeline runs on a workstation. The Jena version matches JENA_VERSION there, and the Fuseki tarball hash matches JENA_FUSEKI_SHA512 there, verified 2026-08-24.

java.comment: Jena 6.2.0 requires Java 21 (class file 65). Any Java 21 runtime serves; this tarball keeps the workstation setup reproducible without a package install. The hosts use the reviewed openjdk-21-jre-headless package instead.
